mostWorthwhile.text: Following water through fractured rock to a spring was most worthwhile: the less permeable layer gave a clear explanation of why groundwater can reappear elsewhere.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial pool-to-runoff sequence was straightforward, with only one offered action at each point, though it established the landscape.

surprise.text: The less permeable layer diverted groundwater sideways rather than simply stopping its movement, setting up the spring.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the offered combinations had clear physical purposes, although most were the only available action.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the young sea and landscape change, especially if later combinations explain natural processes as clearly as the groundwater route.
